RULING: TYPEFACE DIRECTION for M7 artwork is OLD-STYLE / HUMANIST SERIF — Garamond, Sabon, Jenson lineage. NOT Didone.
the_DIRECTION_is_chosen_the_FACE_is_not: explicitly: no specific typeface is chosen by this ruling. The face remains an OPEN OWNER DECISION, to be made against specimens at true print scale. The specimen sheet at docs/roadmap/palt_m7/typeface_specimen/ serves that decision and commits nothing.
why_this_location: docs/roadmap/palt_m4c/ holds the M7 design-scope rulings (m7_artwork_scope_ruling.json, m7_dependency_narrowing_ruling.json); direction decisions sit beside scope decisions
